tools.name: Bash
tools.description: Executes a given bash command and returns its output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does

tools.name: Read
tools.description: Reads a file from the filesystem. Can read text files, images, and PDFs. For images, returns base64-encoded frames for visual inspection. For PDFs, use the pages parameter to render specific pages as images.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read.

offset.description: The line number to start reading from (1-based).

limit.description: The number of lines to read.

tools.name: Write
tools.description: Writes a file to the filesystem. Creates parent directories if needed. Overwrites the existing file if there is one at the provided path.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to write.

content.description: The content to write to the file.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description: Performs exact string replacements in files. The edit will fail if old_string is not found or is not unique (unless replace_all is set).

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to modify.

new_string.description: The text to replace it with.

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false).

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Fast file pattern matching tool. Supports glob patterns like '**/*.js' or 'src/**/*.ts'. Returns matching file paths.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against.

path.description: The directory to search in. Defaults to /workspace.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description: Search tool for finding patterns in file contents. Supports regex syntax. Returns matching lines or file paths.

pattern.description: The regex pattern to search for.

path.description: File or directory to search in. Defaults to /workspace.

context_lines.description: Number of context lines before and after each match.

after_context.description: Number of lines to show after each match.

before_context.description: Number of lines to show before each match.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N entries.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where patterns can span lines.

tools.name: BrowserScreenshot
tools.description: Capture screenshots of a web page over time. Opens the URL in a headless browser, then takes multiple screenshots at regular intervals to show animation progress. Use this to preview and verify your generated web pages and animations.

url.description: The URL to navigate to and capture.

tools.name: ReadMedia
tools.description: Read and preview a video file. Extracts frames at specified intervals. Returns metadata and base64-encoded frame images.

media_type.description: Type of media: 'auto', 'image', 'video', or 'pdf'. Default: auto-detect.

max_frames.description: Maximum number of frames to extract (default: 8).

end_time.description: End time in seconds. None means end of video.

tools.name: Download
tools.description: Download a file as binary (base64-encoded). Use for retrieving generated files (mp4, gif, html, etc.).

path.description: Path to the file to download.

judge_calls.rubric_preview:
你正在评估一份关于JavaScript异步生成器与Proxy微任务执行顺序的分析报告。基于以下评分标准逐项打分：

【正向评分项】（满分100%）
1. [权重15%] 识别scheduler是Thenable对象（有then方法）而非原生Promise — 这是理解await行为的关键
2. [权重15%] 正确给出同步阶段执行序列：Global:Init → P:A:Start → Sched:Then → P:B:Start → Sched:Then → Global:End
3. [权重13%] 正确分析微任务调度层级：Promise.resolve().then 与 queueMic
judge_calls.reasoning: 回答准确且详尽。1. 正确给出了完整的logs序列，反映了对微任务队列和Thenable对象执行顺序的深刻理解。2. 正确判断P:A:End不会打印，并解释了生成器在yield处暂停且未被再次调用的机制。3. 准确分析了buffer.val的值受Inter:1影响变为50，且p1 resolve时返回的是yield出的旧值0。4. 深入解释了Promise.then与嵌套queueMicrotask之间的微任务优先级差异。完全符合评分标准。
